svg.title: Smart Hospital Assistant Robot car unit wiring diagram
svg.desc: Corrected full wiring diagram for the car unit covering the IR array, ultrasonic sensor, ESP32-CAM, LCD level shifter, drive and chassis, ESP32 pin map, echo divider, L298N motor driver, lock servo, buzzer and LED, power supply, and a list of corrections from the previous version.
svg.text: SMART HOSPITAL ASSISTANT ROBOT — CAR UNIT COMPLETE WIRING DIAGRAM
ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin) + ESP32-CAM • 2WD rear drive, front ball caster • 3S LiPo, dual buck rails
Polarity: white = LOW, BLACK = HIGH. Marker = all five HIGH.
NEVER wire ECHO straight to a GPIO — 5V into a 3.6V max pin.
No UART to the ESP32. Wi-Fi to the PC.
GPIO0 → GND only while flashing, then REMOVE the jumper.
LV3 → GPIO18 HV3 → lock servo signal
I2C address 0x27 or 0x3F. LV must never exceed HV.
IR array at leading edge, 10mm off floor
GPIO18 PWM Lock servo → BSS138 LV3
Measure the midpoint with a meter BEFORE it touches GPIO4.
+12V terminal ← 7.5V from BUCK 1 — NEVER the 11.1V battery
+5V terminal ← 5V logic rail (it is an INPUT once 5V-EN is removed)
orange (signal) → BSS138 HV3 ← driven from GPIO18
470µF across red / brown, close to the connector
NEVER actuate the servo while the motors run — it browns out the ESP32-CAM.
BUCK 2 (5.00V): ESP32 VIN · CAM 5V · LCD · HC-SR04
LiPo alarm on the balance connector — leave it plugged in
Set BOTH bucks with NO LOAD connected. All GNDs bond to ONE star point.
12) CORRECTED FROM THE PREVIOUS DIAGRAM — verify each before powering on
✕ "Motors powered from battery via L298N 12V" → motors run off BUCK 1 at 7.5V. 11.1V destroys 3–6V motors.
✕ Pan / tilt servos on GPIO13 and GPIO4 → removed. Those pins are HC-SR04 TRIG and ECHO. This project has no pan/tilt.
✕ "ESP32 ↔ ESP32-CAM via UART TX2/RX2" → removed. The CAM has 5V and GND only and talks to the PC over Wi-Fi.
✕ GPIO16 / GPIO17 labelled RX2 / TX2 → GPIO16 is the status LED (output), GPIO17 is IR array OUT5 (input).
✕ GPIO12 shown in use → removed. It is a strapping pin; this design uses none.
+ Added: LiPo low-voltage alarm · 1000µF on the motor rail · 100nF per motor · ball caster · BSS138 path for the servo signal · GPIO33 spare.
